description: Every Auth Core service-token request quarry-edge makes, in one file. It is read by the Rust loader (ServiceTokenRequest::from_manifest in crates/quarry-runtime/src/service_tokens.rs), by the tests that tie each row to its call site and to the request Auth Core really receives, and, as a byte-for-byte vendored copy pinned by the sha256 beside it, by Auth Core's contract spec (QB-T02, CR-T17). A token request that is not a row here cannot be built, and a row with no call site fails the source scan unless it is marked pending. Retention posture is never part of a request: Auth Core selects it from the registry and refuses a request that names one. granted=true means the registry must allow quarry-edge exactly this audience and these scopes. granted=false means the registry must refuse it today and every caller of the row degrades; flipping the field is then the only manifest change a grant needs. To change a row: edit this file, refresh cross-plane-token-requests.json.sha256, update the digest registered in scripts/tests/zdr-contract-sync.test.sh and re-vendor the copies listed there.

rows.name: vector-retrieve
rows.notes: Vector leg of hybrid search: POST /v1/retrieve on the Data Plane retrieval engine. Read-only. It never carries org:data:read_all: that scope marks a system write and belongs to the ingest row alone.

rows.name: ingest
rows.notes: Persistence of crawled pages: POST /v1/documents on the Data Plane. org:data:read_all marks a system ingest, so documents-api stamps crawled pages visibility=org; without it they land private to service:quarry-edge and no user sees them. Never requested for a ZDR run.

rows.name: web-rerank
rows.pending: QB-T09 adds the Data Plane rerank client and its call site, then fills used_by and removes this field. The registry grant of data:rerank to quarry-edge is the Control Plane principal bundle (CP wave P1, QB-T01).
rows.notes: Rerank of caller-supplied web candidates: POST /v1/rerank on the Data Plane (paid Azure Cohere). A request of its own on purpose: no other scope rides with data:rerank and no other row holds it. Never audience model-gateway: reranking uses neither the Model Plane nor a subscription.

rows.name: model-invoke
rows.notes: Model Plane POST /v1/invoke, used by intent classification, autoprompt, the semantic reranker, page titles, ai-formats and answer synthesis. The registry gives quarry-edge no model-gateway audience, so Auth Core refuses the mint with 403 and each of those callers degrades (decision D16, owned by QB-T17). Flip granted only together with a registry grant.

rows.name: model-stream
rows.notes: Model Plane POST /v1/invoke/stream, used by streamed answers and ai-formats. Refused today for the same reason as model-invoke (D16, QB-T17).

rows.name: model-audio
rows.notes: POST /v1/audio, forwarded to /v1/ai/speech and /v1/ai/transcribe. Refused today for the same reason as model-invoke (D16, QB-T17).
